description:
Cast Treebeard either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {2}{G}{W} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Treebeard enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, creating two Food, two Clue and two Treasure tokens.
Activate the Food, Clue and Treasure tokens by tapping them, adding {3}{G}{G}{W}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Treebeard from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
